author: Seung Wook
problem: Given each day's profit (negative for a loss), return the largest total over any run of one or more consecutive days.
bug_description: best starts at 0 instead of daily[0], so when every day is a loss it returns 0 even though at least one day must be chosen.

comments.accurate: Largest total profit over any run of at least one consecutive day
comments.wrong_behavior: Largest total profit over any run of consecutive days, or 0 if every day is a loss
comments.wrong_location: Starting value verified; check that current restarts when a run turns negative
